## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed. Link a relevant issue if available.

## Validation

List the checks performed and their outcomes. Explain failures or checks that
could not run. Include screenshots only for visual changes.

## Review Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and follows the [contribution guide](https://github.com/PublicData-stream/pdf2md.mcp/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] Tests cover executable behavior changes, or the reason no tests apply is explained.
- [ ] Documentation reflects any setup, command, configuration, or interface changes.
- [ ] Temporary output, credentials, and private documents are excluded.
- [ ] Public explanations follow the [information and reference policy](https://github.com/PublicData-stream/pdf2md.mcp/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#public-information-and-references), using accessible sources or sanitized inline context.
- [ ] Relevant security effects have been considered; undisclosed vulnerabilities follow the [private reporting policy](https://github.com/PublicData-stream/pdf2md.mcp/blob/main/SECURITY.md).
